rules.name: Glory Hound
rules.description: Must give a Charge order to units in command and Charge range of an opposing unit when this unit is activated.

rules.name: Drilled
rules.description: If all the models in a unit of 5 or more models with this trait are in base to base contact with each other, the unit is considered to be In Formation. While In Formation, the unit gains the Big Target trait, the Intimidating trait, and a -1 bonus to its Melee Save tests. When the unit includes a Non-Commissioned Officer, it also gains a -1 bonus to its Resolve tests.

rules.name: Marksman
rules.description: This unit may target specific models within range and line of sight when shooting. If any hits are scored, the targeted model must perform the Shoot Save test, and is removed as a casualty if it fails.

4d10 for Shoot tests, each natural 10 rolled yields an additional d10 roll to hit.

rules.name: Musician
rules.description:
Add a single model to the Leader Unit to act as a Musician.
The Leader’s command range is doubled while this model is part of the unit.
Armed as modeled.

rules.name: Non-Commissioned Officer
rules.description:
Designate a single model to be a Non-Commissioned Officer (NCO).
The NCO’s unit counts as being in command range as long as this model is still part of it.
A formed unit with an NCO gains a -1 bonus to its Resolve.
